_comment: Slot-fillable phrases per dim token in en + es. Each entry is either a plain string (LOCATION, OBJECT_FOCUS — referential stability), a list of 3-5 interchangeable variants, or (for top-NPC PRESENCE tokens: Countess Morvaine, Carlo Bassi, Dr Klaus Winter) a dict of voice-arc stages cold/warming/breaking/broken. The composer picks variants deterministically by hash(turn_idx, token_id). Voice: third-person past, methodical, cold, reconstructive — Obra Dinn cartouche cadence adapted to Venetian Carnevale Baroque. The detective is referred to as 'the inspector' (en) / 'el inspector' (es).
